summary.en: The Detective Boys are on the streets when Conan mentions to Haibara that he texted Masumi about the identity of the mysterious child and got the reply of "the little sister from outside the domain". They encounter a drug dealer and are to solve a code left by the dealer's notebook. This will determine the next drug transaction happening on the day itself. Conan and Heiji solved the code and found out the deal will be on Dec 3rd, at Ebisubashi bridge in Osaka, 12 pm. Heiji is dealing the situation in Osaka physically while Conan figures out who the trading partner is through a video chat.
